versions.short: The resolution expresses support for designating the first week of August 2026 as National Community Health Center Week. It honors the staff, board members, patients, and others who have helped community health centers succeed since the first ones opened about six decades ago. It recognizes the centers' important role in the country's health system and encourages people across the United States to visit their local community health center and celebrate the partnership between the centers and the communities they serve.
